Weekend classes fill the quiet days.

handy.blurb: Fix, assemble and renovate small jobs for households and landlords.

opts.d: Cheaper by 15%, but audit and quality risk.

Custom apps and system integrations at normal rates.

webdev.blurb: Build websites, apps and internal systems for clients. Developers cost a lot and scope creep never sleeps.

opts.d: Steady clients on a monthly fee.

mktg.blurb: Run campaigns for other companies. If you own one, your own companies can use it for their marketing.

opts.d: Clients pay for the hours you put in.

law.blurb: Sell legal advice by the hour. Needs a licensed lawyer. Own companies can use it for contracts and disputes.

opts.d: Accounts, tax and advice for the same clients.
Run payroll for your clients every month.

acctfirm.blurb: Do bookkeeping and tax for other businesses. Deadlines drive the year. Your own limited companies can use you.

opts.d: Electricians, welders and engineers: higher rates, fewer placements.
A placement fee when the client keeps them.

staffing.blurb: Place temporary workers at client companies. Big revenue, thin margin, strict rules on hiring out labour.

opts.d: Cuts and colour by appointment, at normal prices.
Shampoo and styling at the till.

opts.d: Weekly lessons at the usual pace.
A second kind of pupil. Needs a bike.
Pupils study at home and book their lessons with you.

drivsk.blurb: Teach people to drive. Training cars, approved instructors and a pass rate to protect.

opts.d: Some private patients, some on the public scheme.
Back and knee classes in the evenings.
Higher fees, more time on the road.

physio.blurb: Treat patients with a mix of private payment and public refunds. Authorisation matters and the clinical lead carries the risk.

Find tenants for landlords for a fee.
Banks and owners pay for a valuation.

opts.d: A wash and cut while they stay.
A van collects the dogs in the morning.

pets.blurb: Daycare, boarding and grooming. Animals get sick, owners complain.

Lower prices, more cars back with problems.

fun.blurb: Bowling, arcade or escape rooms with a bar. Birthday parties pay the bills.
